methods.body:
const w = d.w, h = d.h
        const mid = h * 0.74
        const amp = h * 0.60
        d.strokeStyle = "rgba(244,247,251,0.85)"
        d.lineWidth = 2
        d.beginPath()
        for (let i = 0; i <= 60; i++) {
            const t = i / 60
            const x = t * w
            const y = mid - Math.sin((t - 0.08) / 0.84 * Math.PI) * amp
            if (i == 0) d.moveTo(x, y); else d.lineTo(x, y)
        }
        d.stroke()
        d.strokeStyle = "rgba(244,247,251,0.45)"
        d.lineWidth = 1
        d.beginPath(); d.moveTo(0, mid); d.lineTo(w, mid); d.stroke()
        const t = 0.08 + this.frac * 0.84
        const x = t * w, y = mid - Math.sin((t - 0.08) / 0.84 * Math.PI) * amp
        const glow = d.createRadialGradient(x, y, 0, x, y, 14)
        glow.addColorStop(0, "rgba(255,255,255,0.9)")
        glow.addColorStop(1, "rgba(255,255,255,0)")
        d.fillStyle = glow
        d.beginPath(); d.arc(x, y, 14, 0, Math.PI * 2); d.fill()
        d.fillStyle = "#FFFFFF"
        d.beginPath(); d.arc(x, y, 5, 0, Math.PI * 2); d.fill()

methods.name: draw
methods.body:
const w = d.w, h = d.h
        const cx = w / 2, cy = h / 2
        const R = Math.min(w, h) / 2 - 4
        d.strokeStyle = "rgba(244,247,251,0.5)"
        d.lineCap = "round"
        for (let i = 0; i < 72; i++) {
            const a = (i / 72) * Math.PI * 2
            const long = i % 18 == 0
            d.lineWidth = long ? 2 : 1
            d.globalAlpha = long ? 0.9 : 0.45
            d.beginPath()
            d.moveTo(cx + Math.cos(a) * (R - (long ? 7 : 4)), cy + Math.sin(a) * (R - (long ? 7 : 4)))
            d.lineTo(cx + Math.cos(a) * R, cy + Math.sin(a) * R)
            d.stroke()
        }
        d.globalAlpha = 1
        const a = (this.deg - 90) * Math.PI / 180
        d.strokeStyle = "#FFFFFF"
        d.lineWidth = 2.5
        // the needle leaves the middle clear: the readout lives there
        const hole = 22
        d.beginPath()
        d.moveTo(cx + Math.cos(a) * hole, cy + Math.sin(a) * hole)
        d.lineTo(cx + Math.cos(a) * (R - 10), cy + Math.sin(a) * (R - 10))
        d.stroke()
        d.beginPath()
        d.moveTo(cx - Math.cos(a) * hole, cy - Math.sin(a) * hole)
        d.lineTo(cx - Math.cos(a) * (R - 16), cy - Math.sin(a) * (R - 16))
        d.stroke()
        // arrowhead
        d.save()
        d.translate(cx + Math.cos(a) * (R - 10), cy + Math.sin(a) * (R - 10))
        d.rotate(a)
        d.fillStyle = "#FFFFFF"
        d.beginPath(); d.moveTo(7, 0); d.lineTo(-4, -5); d.lineTo(-4, 5); d.closePath(); d.fill()
        d.restore()
        // tail dot
        d.fillStyle = "#FFFFFF"
        d.beginPath()
        d.arc(cx - Math.cos(a) * (R - 14), cy - Math.sin(a) * (R - 14), 4, 0, Math.PI * 2)
        d.fill()
        // the cardinals ride the ring itself, drawn — so no overlay text can
        // ever collide with the readout in the middle
        d.fillStyle = "rgba(244,247,251,0.7)"
        d.font = "600 11px system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif"
        d.textAlign = "center"
        d.textBaseline = "middle"
        const rl = R - 15
        d.fillText("N", cx, cy - rl)
        d.fillText("S", cx, cy + rl)
        d.fillText("W", cx - rl, cy)
        d.fillText("E", cx + rl, cy)

methods.body:
const w = d.w, h = d.h
        const cx = w / 2, cy = h * 0.56
        const R = Math.min(w, h) / 2 - 4
        const a0 = Math.PI * 0.75, a1 = Math.PI * 2.25
        d.strokeStyle = "rgba(244,247,251,0.5)"
        d.lineCap = "round"
        for (let i = 0; i <= 48; i++) {
            const a = a0 + (i / 48) * (a1 - a0)
            const long = i % 8 == 0
            d.lineWidth = long ? 2 : 1
            d.globalAlpha = long ? 0.9 : 0.45
            d.beginPath()
            d.moveTo(cx + Math.cos(a) * (R - (long ? 8 : 5)), cy + Math.sin(a) * (R - (long ? 8 : 5)))
            d.lineTo(cx + Math.cos(a) * R, cy + Math.sin(a) * R)
            d.stroke()
        }
        d.globalAlpha = 1
        const a = a0 + this.frac * (a1 - a0)
        d.strokeStyle = "#FFFFFF"
        d.lineWidth = 3
        d.beginPath()
        d.moveTo(cx + Math.cos(a) * (R - 18), cy + Math.sin(a) * (R - 18))
        d.lineTo(cx + Math.cos(a) * (R - 2), cy + Math.sin(a) * (R - 2))
        d.stroke()
        d.strokeStyle = "rgba(244,247,251,0.9)"
        d.lineWidth = 2
        d.beginPath(); d.moveTo(cx - 7, cy - 26); d.lineTo(cx + 7, cy - 26); d.stroke()
        d.beginPath(); d.moveTo(cx - 7, cy - 20); d.lineTo(cx + 7, cy - 20); d.stroke()

methods.body:
const w = d.w, h = d.h
        const R = Math.min(w, h) / 2
        if (R <= 0) return
        const cx = w / 2, cy = h / 2
        const k = this.illum * 2 - 1          // -1 new … +1 full
        const lit0 = this.waning ? Math.PI / 2 : -Math.PI / 2
        const lit1 = this.waning ? Math.PI * 1.5 : Math.PI / 2

        d.save()
        d.beginPath()
        d.arc(cx, cy, R, 0, Math.PI * 2)
        d.clip()

        d.fillStyle = "#050912"
        d.fillRect(0, 0, w, h)

        d.globalCompositeOperation = "destination-out"
        d.fillStyle = "#000000"
        d.beginPath()
        d.arc(cx, cy, R, lit0, lit1)
        d.closePath()
        d.fill()

        if (k > 0) {                          // gibbous — the lit side grows
            d.beginPath()
            d.ellipse(cx, cy, R * k, R, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2)
            d.fill()
        }
        d.restore()

        if (k < 0) {                          // crescent — the dark side eats in
            d.save()
            d.beginPath()
            d.arc(cx, cy, R, 0, Math.PI * 2)
            d.clip()
            d.fillStyle = "#050912"
            d.beginPath()
            d.ellipse(cx, cy, R * (-k), R, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2)
            d.fill()
            d.restore()
        }
